evidence.title: OpenAI Tells Investors Enterprise Revenue Has Overtaken Its ChatGPT Consumer Business
evidence.body: [e002:f01] Sarah Friar made the disclosure in an investor meeting held days after a run of senior departures, telling attendees the two revenue lines had crossed well ahead of schedule, CNBC reported , citing a person in attendance and slides from the presentation. [e002:f02] “We entered the year at 60-40, but enterprise has accelerated much faster than expected and those lines have now crossed,” Friar said, according to the person, who asked not to be named due to confidentiality. [e002:f03] “The majority of our revenue is now enterprise.” The same materials put OpenAI’s annualized revenue run rate at $40 billion, up 20% month over month in July 2026, with business customer count growing 32% in the same period. [e002:f04] Advertising, which OpenAI began testing in ChatGPT on February 9, 2026, is approaching a $1 billion annual run rate, Friar told the group. [e002:f05] Denise Dresser, OpenAI’s chief revenue officer, stepped down on August 13, 2026, eight months into the role she took after more than a decade at Salesforce and a stint as CEO of Slack. [e002:f06] In an August 13, 2026 announcement , OpenAI appointed Dali Rajic as chief revenue officer, arriving from Wiz, where he was president and chief operating officer through the cybersecurity company’s acquisition by Google. [e002:f07] The announcement put OpenAI’s current reach at more than one billion weekly active users and more than two million businesses, twice the business count of a year earlier. [e002:f08] OpenAI passed 1 million paying business customers in November 2025 , counting organizations paying through ChatGPT for Work or consuming models through the developer platform. [e002:f09] When OpenAI closed a $122 billion funding round on March 31, 2026 , at a post-money valuation of $852 billion, it stated enterprise made up more than 40% of revenue and was “on track to reach parity with consumer by the end of 2026.” Friar repeated that parity-by-year-end guidance publicly earlier this year. [e002:f10] The August 14 disclosure moves the milestone up by roughly two quarters, against a revenue base that stood at $20 billion-plus annualized at the end of 2025, according to Friar’s own January 18, 2026 business review . [e002:f11] She pointed to OpenAI’s newest model as 54% more efficient on agentic coding tasks, alongside recent price cuts across the model suite. [e002:f12] What OpenAI’s Own Data Says About the Shift Two days before the investor meeting, OpenAI published its own enterprise usage research on August 12, 2026 , which documents where the enterprise growth is coming from. [e002:f13] Codex, the company’s coding agent, generated 64% of combined Codex and ChatGPT output tokens among enterprise customers as of June 2026, evidence that business usage has moved from question-answering toward delegated, multi-step work. [e002:f14] The top 10% of firms by usage intensity now generate 8.3 times as many output tokens per active user as typical firms, a gap that has tripled since January 2026. [e002:f15] The consumer engine behind the other half of the business remains the distribution channel: OpenAI reported more than 900 million weekly active users and over 50 million subscribers in March 2026. [e002:f16] The ads test that began in the United States in February was announced in late March as expanding in the coming weeks to Canada, Australia, and New Zealand, and reached the United Kingdom, Mexico, Brazil, Japan, and South Korea on August 11, 2026 , with Plus, Pro, Business, Enterprise, and Education tiers remaining ad-free.

evidence.title: OpenAI launches Computer History in ChatGPT for macOS
evidence.body: [e003:f01] The feature lets ChatGPT and Codex reference a user's recent activity across apps and websites. [e003:f02] It is available to ChatGPT Pro, Business, and Enterprise users and is off by default. [e003:f03] Business and Enterprise users also need an administrator to grant access before they can choose to enable it. [e003:f04] Computer History replaces OpenAI's earlier Chronicle research preview, but it has been rebuilt rather than simply renamed. [e003:f05] Unlike Chronicle, which used screenshots, the new system records interaction events such as clicks, typing, keyboard shortcuts, app switches, and context exposed through the macOS accessibility system. [e003:f06] The feature creates an interaction-event stream from approved apps and websites, then periodically turns those events into text summaries and local memory files. [e003:f07] Users can ask ChatGPT about recent work, including what they were doing before a break, where to find a document they were using earlier, or for a summary of tasks completed during the day. [e003:f08] Access controls The feature depends on OpenAI's Memories setting and cannot be used with an API key or Amazon Bedrock. [e003:f09] For workplace accounts, access is governed by several layers of control. [e003:f10] Computer History also does not capture screenshots, screen recordings, microphone input, or system audio, and does not require macOS screen recording permission. [e003:f11] Local storage Temporary event files are stored on the user's Mac for up to 48 hours and are isolated within the ChatGPT app group. [e003:f12] OpenAI said the memory files are not encrypted by Computer History and may be accessible to other programs running under the same macOS user account. [e003:f13] OpenAI says it does not retain those event files after processing unless required by law and does not use them for training. [e003:f14] Chat content may be used to improve OpenAI's models if the user's ChatGPT data controls allow it. [e003:f15] Risk warning OpenAI warned that Computer History increases the risk of prompt injection from content in apps and websites, giving the example of a malicious website containing instructions that ChatGPT or Codex might follow. [e003:f16] Computer History uses tokens to summarise activity and create memories, extending OpenAI's effort to turn routine computer use into reusable prompts, records, and automations inside ChatGPT.

evidence.title: Axios Bets on OpenAI Partnership to Expand Local New
evidence.body: [e004:f01] The three-year agreement is supporting the launch of 13 Axios Local newsletters. [e004:f02] OpenAI is providing funding for the expansion as well as access to its enterprise AI tools, while Axios is allowing OpenAI to train its models on the publisher’s freely available journalism. [e004:f03] For Axios co-founder and CEO Jim VandeHei , the partnership is part of a larger experiment: determining whether technology can automate enough of the administrative and repetitive work involved in running a local newsroom to allow journalists to spend more time reporting. [e004:f04] The initiative comes as local news organizations across the country continue to grapple with shrinking revenue, newsroom reductions and the growing influence of generative AI. [e004:f05] Axios began expanding into local news after acquiring the Charlotte Agenda in 2020. [e004:f06] Axios Local journalists report on subjects ranging from elections and city government to restaurants and other community developments. [e004:f07] The OpenAI relationship significantly expands that strategy. [e004:f08] The partnership was announced in January 2025 with funding for new Axios operations in Pittsburgh; Kansas City, Missouri; Boulder, Colorado; and Huntsville, Alabama . [e004:f09] Axios COO Allison Murphy said OpenAI’s investment was sufficient to cover startup costs in the new markets, including personnel and technology. [e004:f10] The partnership has nevertheless generated concerns about transparency, editorial independence and whether individual deals between large publishers and AI companies can address the broader financial problems confronting local journalism. [e004:f11] VandeHei said the agreement does not specifically spell out an editorial firewall because both organizations regarded Axios’ independence as understood. [e004:f12] Axios journalists have continued reporting critically on OpenAI and on issues involving AI infrastructure in local communities. [e004:f13] Critics also question whether the model will help communities with the greatest need for new reporting. [e004:f14] Axios Local, meanwhile, has surpassed two million subscribers but is not yet profitable. [e004:f15] VandeHei has said achieving profitability in individual markets within five years would represent a significant success. [e004:f16] The experiment could provide an early test of whether AI can lower the operating costs of local journalism without replacing the reporters responsible for producing it.

evidence.title: IBM partners with OpenAI to expand enterprise access to AI models and tools
evidence.body: [e005:f01] Through the collaboration, OpenAI will gain an additional channel for engaging with large companies via IBM’s international consulting division. [e005:f02] The companies intend to jointly deploy AI solutions and create specialized products for the financial industry, public sector, telecommunications companies, and retail. [e005:f03] The financial and other commercial terms of the agreement were not disclosed. [e005:f04] The new agreement with OpenAI was reached less than a year after IBM formed a similar partnership with Anthropic. [e005:f05] It is part of IBM’s strategy of working with multiple AI model providers rather than relying solely on its own developments. [e005:f06] In the coming months, IBM plans to train and certify tens of thousands of consultants. [e005:f07] IBM Consulting Managing Partner Mike Healy told TechCrunch that the training program will cover the following areas: OpenAI Codex; OpenAI APIs; cybersecurity; certifications related to AI consulting solutions. [e005:f08] IBM will also form a team of specialized “Forward Deployed Experts.” They will be trained through OpenAI’s partner network to work directly with clients on implementing artificial intelligence technologies. [e005:f09] GPT-5.6, Codex, and ChatGPT Work to be integrated into IBM’s platform GPT-5.6, Codex, and ChatGPT Work are planned to be integrated into the IBM Consulting Advantage platform. [e005:f10] For IBM, the collaboration with OpenAI complements the company’s model-agnostic approach. [e005:f11] IBM and OpenAI partnership in cybersecurity The agreement also expands IBM and OpenAI’s cybersecurity collaboration. [e005:f12] In June, the companies launched the OpenAI Daybreak Cyber Partner Program. [e005:f13] As part of the new partnership, OpenAI models will be integrated with IBM Autonomous Security. [e005:f14] We recommend paying attention to: Databricks raised $5 billion in new funding, pushing its valuation to $190 billion as demand for enterprise data and artificial intelligence tools accelerates. [e005:f15] The White House has joined the debate over AI safety checks, focusing on closed models while open systems remain outside the voluntary review process. [e005:f16] Meta has launched Muse Code in beta, an AI coding agent designed to handle large software repositories by planning changes, writing code, and verifying results.

evidence.title: OpenAI Appoints Dali Rajic As New CRO Amid Executive Shake-up
evidence.body: [e006:f01] Read about the impact on the AI firm's potential IPO, revenue strategy, and risks. [e006:f02] OpenAI has announced the appointment of Dali Rajic as its new Chief Revenue Officer (CRO), marking a fresh change in the company's executive leadership. [e006:f03] Rajic, who previously served in a senior role at Wiz, succeeds Denise Dresser, who held the position for nine months. [e006:f04] This appointment is the latest in a series of leadership shifts at the artificial intelligence firm as it navigates a critical phase of organizational growth and preparation for a potential public offering. [e006:f05] This change comes shortly after the departures of Chief Operating Officer Brad Lightcap and Fidji Simo, who served as the CEO of AGI deployment. [e006:f06] OpenAI remains a private company and is not currently listed on any public stock exchange, including the NSE or BSE in India. [e006:f07] Preparing for a Public Listing OpenAI has confidentially filed a draft registration statement with the U.S. [e006:f08] The company is under pressure to demonstrate that its massive investment in AI technology can translate into consistent, repeatable business revenue. [e006:f09] While the firm reports having millions of business clients, executive leadership has indicated that the company is still working to meet its revenue targets consistently. [e006:f10] Rajic’s focus will likely be on sharpening the company’s sales strategy to ensure these targets are achieved. [e006:f11] For investors following the global technology sector, the primary challenge for OpenAI lies in proving its long-term financial viability. [e006:f12] Any executive reshuffle, therefore, serves as a signal of how the company intends to pivot its operations to be more enterprise-focused and financially disciplined. [e006:f13] This structure presents unique challenges that potential public market investors may examine closely. [e006:f14] Furthermore, the immense compute costs required to train and maintain advanced AI models pose a continuous challenge to profitability. [e006:f15] As OpenAI moves forward, the primary monitorables for observers will be the stability of its new leadership team and the clarity of its path toward sustainable profitability. [e006:f16] Any future updates regarding the timeline of the potential IPO or further changes in the management hierarchy will likely remain the next important markers for the company's progress.

evidence.title: OpenAIが最大80％値下げ、ジェボンズのパラドックスが収益成長を後押し
evidence.body: [e007:f01] OpenAIは主力モデル「GPT-5.6 Luna」の価格を80％、中級モデル「Terra」を20％引き下げた。 [e007:f02] TD CowenのアナリストはOpenRouterのデータを分析し、Lunaの実効価格が約10分の1に低下した一方、利用量は約14倍に増加したと試算した。 [e007:f03] Lunaの収益は値下げ前の週と比較して34％増、Terraは45％増となった。 [e007:f04] この現象は、資源が安くなると消費が減るどころか増えるという19世紀の観察「ジェボンズのパラドックス」を裏付けるものだ。 [e007:f05] Rampのデータでも、OpenAIの安価なモデル「GPT-5.6 Sol」がAnthropicの高価な「Fable 5」よりも多くの企業支出を集めたことが示されている。 [e007:f06] TD Cowenの試算によると、OpenAIのLunaからの収益は値下げ前の7日間と比較して約34％増加し、Terraからの収益は約45％増加した。 [e007:f07] 経済学者ウィリアム・スタンレー・ジェボンズは、石炭利用の効率が向上しても消費が減るどころか、むしろ急激に増加したことに気づいた。 [e007:f08] 今日では、かつてのコンピューターを凌ぐ性能のスマートフォンが約400ドル（約6万4000円）で買える。 [e007:f09] 価格の劇的な下落にもかかわらず、Appleは直近四半期に1090億ドル（約17兆3700億円）の収益を上げた。 [e007:f10] 1980年の上場時の年間収益は1億ドル強だった。 [e007:f11] モデル利用データ モデル 実効価格の変化 利用量の変化 推定収益変化 GPT-5.6 Luna 約10分の1に低下 約14倍に増加 +34％ Terra 約3分の1に低下 約5倍に増加 +45％ 注：OpenAIの値下げ後約2週間のデータ。 [e007:f12] 製品を80％値下げして収益が増えることはまれだ。 [e007:f13] ところがこのケースでは、わずか2週間で収益が3分の1増加した。 [e007:f14] OpenAIの「GPT-5.6 Sol」が7月、Anthropicの最上位モデル「Fable 5」よりも多くの企業支出を集めたことがわかった。 [e007:f15] 考えられる理由は、OpenAIモデルの価格の安さだ。 [e007:f16] ただし、TD Cowenの結果はOpenAIの値下げ後わずか約2週間を対象としており、収益増加が持続するか判断するには時期尚早だ。

evidence.title: OpenAIがCRO交代 企業営業を強化しIPO加速
evidence.body: [e008:f01] 10:03 オープンAIの最高経営責任者（CEO）、サム・オルトマン。 [e008:f02] /聯合ニュース 新規株式公開（IPO）を推進中のOpenAIが、企業顧客向け営業分野を率いてきた最高売上責任者（CRO）を1年も経たないうちに交代させた。 [e008:f03] OpenAIはクラウドセキュリティ企業Wizの社長兼最高執行責任者（COO）出身であるダリ・ラジックを新任CROに任命すると13日（現地時間）発表した。 [e008:f04] ラジック新任CROは主要情報技術（IT）企業で営業組織を率いてきた人物である。 [e008:f05] ラジックの合流により、昨年12月にセールスフォースから招聘したスラック最高経営責任者（CEO）出身のデニス・ドレッサーは8カ月でOpenAIを去る。 [e008:f06] OpenAIは「デニスが引き継ぎ期間を経た後、新たな機会を探すためにOpenAIを離れることを決めた」と説明した。 [e008:f07] ドレッサーは自身のリンクトインのアカウントを通じて「会社の将来の要件に関する議論を経て、円滑な引き継ぎのためにグレッグ・ブロックマン社長と協力している」と述べた。 [e008:f08] ブロックマン社長は今回のCRO交代に関連して「技術を導入する方式が急速に変化している」とし、「ダリはAIが人と企業に幅広く有用に活用されるよう、我々が積み上げてきた経験を反復可能な実行力へと転換する」と語った。 [e008:f09] OpenAIは6月に米国証券取引委員会（SEC）に非公開IPOの申請書を提出し、上場手続きを進めている。 [e008:f10] 今回のCRO交代は、OpenAIが上場を前に企業顧客向け事業を拡大しようとする中で行われた。 [e008:f11] OpenAIは競合のAnthropicと比べ、これまで個人利用者を中心に成長してきた分、収益寄与度の高い企業顧客の売上比率が相対的に低いとの評価を受けてきた。 [e008:f12] OpenAIは年末までに企業顧客の売上を高め、個人顧客向け売上と同率にするとの目標を繰り返し明らかにしてきた。 [e008:f13] 一方、OpenAIでは最近、最高経営陣の離脱も相次いでいる。 [e008:f14] 事業部門CEOを務めてきたフィジ・シモは持病の治療のため先月辞任し、ブラッド・ライトキャップ前最高執行責任者（COO）も11日に退社した。 [e008:f15] ※ 本記事はAIで翻訳されています。 [e008:f16] あわせて読みたい記事 イッタ半導体がノーコード設計自動化を推進 AI時代の設計インフラを目指す MSIがマルチヘッドAFM開発 製造装置内計測で市場開拓へ SKハイニックス少額株主346万人超に急増。

ẢNH: REUTERS](https:// OpenAIのロゴ。 [e001:f03] 写真：ロイター OpenAIは、高度化するサイバー攻撃に対する防御を強化するために、パートナー企業に適切なAIツールを提供する目的で、サイバーセキュリティ専門プログラム「Daybreak」の拡充を発表した。 [e001:f04] OpenAIは昨年5月、競合企業であるAnthropicがサイバーセキュリティアライアンス「Project Glasswing」を立ち上げた直後に、Daybreakを初めて発表した。 [e001:f05] OpenAIはDaybreakを、エコシステム内のパートナー企業が高度なAIモデルにアクセスし、急速に変化するサイバーセキュリティ環境に対応できるようにするプログラムとして位置付けている。 [e001:f06] ](https:// - デジタル経済において、サイバーセキュリティは単なる技術的な問題ではなく、発展の前提条件であり、競争力の構成要素となっています。 [e001:f07] 企業は、サイバーセキュリティへの投資を、発展、ブランドイメージ、そして顧客からの信頼への投資として捉える必要があります。 [e001:f08] 新しい計画によると、デイブレイクはセキュリティ上のニーズに応じて、デイブレイク・ブルーとデイブレイク・レッドという2つのアクセスレベルに分けられる。 [e001:f09] Daybreak Blueを利用することで、参加者はOpenAIの高度で汎用性の高いAIモデルにアクセスできるようになります。 [e001:f10] 一方、Daybreak Redはより高度な機能を提供しており、OpenAIがサイバーセキュリティ向けに特別にトレーニングしたAIモデルを使用して、セキュリティテスト、脆弱性調査、悪用可能性の検証を実行できる。 [e001:f11] OpenAIはDaybreakの拡張に伴い、Daybreak Redユーザー向けの新しいAIモデルであるGPT-5.6-Cyber​​も発表しました。 [e001:f12] OpenAIによると、このモデルは現在利用可能な最も強力なモデルであるGPT-5.6 Solをベースに構築されていますが、サイバーセキュリティ関連の特殊なタスクに最適化されており、処理能力が向上し、この分野における特定の要求に対する拒否率が低下します。 [e001:f13] [Image 8: 「スマート警察署」のキオスク端末モデルが、ハノイで試験的に導入された。 [e001:f14] [Image 9: 「AIボス」が従業員の解雇を初めて決定した。 [e001:f15] [Image 10: ニュース読者の88％は、AIが生成したニュースを読むことに「飽き飽きしている」。 [e001:f16] OpenAIは、サイバーセキュリティ分野におけるAI機能の急速な発展について繰り返し警告を発しており、AIモデルは防御作戦と複雑な技術的タスクの両方を支援できる能力をますます高めている。

evidence.title: OpenAI hired a wave of powerful female executives. Two years later, almost all are gone
evidence.body: [e002:f01] With the departure of chief revenue officer Denise Dresser, OpenAI is losing yet another female voice at the leadership table. [e002:f02] As OpenAI began to transition from a research-focused organization to a true tech giant building out its commercial capacity, the AI leader brought on a spate of experienced execs—many of whom were women. [e002:f03] There was Fidji Simo , leading commercial applications and later nearly the entire business side; Sarah Friar, readying the company for an IPO as CFO; Kate Rouch as CMO; and Denise Dresser, the former CEO of Slack hired as OpenAI’s chief revenue officer. [e002:f04] Recommended Video About two years after that hiring spree began, only one of those executives—Friar—remains in her original role at OpenAI. [e002:f05] Simo and Rouch both left their roles for health reasons (Simo is still working in an advisory role). [e002:f06] Today, it was reported that Dresser is stepping down less than a year after joining OpenAI. [e002:f07] To be fair, the upheaval among OpenAI’s exec ranks has extended to men too; COO Brad Lightcap announced his exit last week. [e002:f08] When OpenAI began hiring this crop of execs, it seemed like a signal that maybe this era of Big Tech could be different. [e002:f09] There are still notable female founders in the space (like Daniela Amodei and Mira Murati). [e002:f10] Within OpenAI, there are rising female execs one level below the top like Ashley Alexander, who leads consumer verticals, and Joy Jiao, who was just elevated under Brockman as head of life sciences. [e002:f11] Once again , we’re reminded of how significant the exit of every female exec from the very top is, when there are still so few. [e002:f12] Within OpenAI, two out of three departures of female execs were due to their health—something out of the control of the company. (Their successors have all been men, though.) AI is transforming our world. [e002:f13] But at least 50 officers have been accused of or charged with using license-plate readers for unauthorized purposes, stalking women, according to a Washington Post investigation . [e002:f14] Flock is now rolling out tools that flag abnormal search behavior to address the issue, as some cities cancel their contracts. [e002:f15] That's how Jennifer Garner says she feels after the IPO of her kids' food brand Once Upon a Farm (she doesn't do either). evidence.title: 【日本オンライン詐欺対策アライアンス（JASA）】新たにOpenAI Japan が参画。業界の壁を越え、「ワンチーム」でのオンライン詐欺撲滅に向け体制を強化 | 一般社団法人トラスト＆セーフティ協会のプレスリリース
evidence.body: [e003:f01] 業界の壁を越え、「ワンチーム」でのオンライン詐欺撲滅に向け体制を強化 〜生成AIのリーディングカンパニーが参画。 [e003:f02] JASAを通した業界連携はさらに前進。 [e003:f03] 〜 一般社団法人トラスト＆セーフティ協会 2026年8月14日 09時00分 トラスト＆セーフティ協会、新たにOpenAI Japanが支援パートナー企業として参画 2026年6月1日に設立に向け発表を行った、一般社団法人トラスト＆セーフティ協会（以下、JTSA）が設立準備を進めている「日本オンライン詐欺対策アライアンス（Japan Anti-Scam Alliance: JASA）」に、この度、新たにOpenAI（OpenAI（米国） ／ 日本拠点：OpenAI Japan）が支援企業として参画合意しました。 [e003:f04] JASAは、巧妙化・大規模化するオンライン詐欺のサプライチェーン（接触・誘導・決済・送金）を分断・抑止するため、特定の企業や業界の枠組みを越え、通信、広告、金融、セキュリティ、そして行政機関が「ワンチーム」となって対策を推進する中立・非営利の協調プラットフォームです。 [e003:f05] OpenAIの参画により、生成AIに関する専門知識と技術的知見が加わり、日本国内におけるオンライン詐欺の対策がさらに強化されることを期待しています。 [e003:f06] ■ JASAとOpenAIの連携 生成AIの急速な普及は、社会に大きな便益をもたらす一方、悪意ある行為者が既存の詐欺手口を効率化・高度化するためにAIを悪用するリスクも高まっています。 [e003:f07] JASAは今後、グローバルな詐欺対策データベースである「 Global Signal Exchange (GSE)」や「 Global Anti-Scam Alliance (GASA)」との実務連携、および 一般財団法人日本サイバー犯罪対策センター （JC3）や 一般社団法人日本インタラクティブ広告協会 （JIAA）等の専門機関、リーディング企業の皆様との業界連携を進めてまいります。 [e003:f08] JASAは、OpenAIの参画を通じて、以下の取り組みを一層推進します。 [e003:f09] 業界横断でのリアルタイム・詐欺シグナルの共有と迅速な遮断（GSE等の活用） 生成AIを悪用した詐欺手口の構造化と、AIを活用した検知・対策の高度化 消費者を守るための、デジタルリテラシー啓発キャンペーン JASAは 本年8月26日（水）にグーグル合同会社渋谷オフィスにて開催予定の「 詐欺対策カンファレンス Japan 2026 」において、主要ステークホルダーが一堂に会するキックオフセレモニーおよび初動成果の報告を行う予定です。 [e003:f10] ■ OpenAIのコメント OpenAI Japan合同会社 公共政策・パートナーシップ統括責任者 大久保和也 OpenAIは、AIの恩恵をすべての人に届けるというミッションのもと、その可能性を広げながら、誰もが安全に活用できる環境を築くことが不可欠だと考えています。 [e003:f11] JASAへの参画を通じて関係者との連携を深め、こうした知見を日本におけるオンライン詐欺対策のさらなる強化につなげてまいります。 [e003:f12] ■ 一般社団法人トラスト＆セーフティ協会（JTSA）代表理事 金谷武明のコメント オンライン詐欺は、もはや一社・一業界だけで防ぎきれる脅威ではありません。 [e003:f13] ■ 一般社団法人トラスト＆セーフティ協会（JTSA）について 一般社団法人トラスト＆セーフティ協会は、デジタルプラットフォームやオンラインサービスにおけるユーザーの安全確保とオンライン環境の信頼性向上に取り組むことを目的に2025年1月に設立されました。 [e003:f14] 日本で唯一のトラスト＆セーフティ実務者のコミュニティとして、デジタル社会の健全な発展に不可欠な「安心・安全」の基盤づくりに貢献してまいります。 [e003:f15] 公式サイト： https:// JASA公式サイト： https:// トラスト＆セーフティとは トラスト＆セーフティ（Trust & Safety）とは、誹謗中傷や偽・誤情報、オンライン詐欺といった脅威に対してユーザー保護、リスクの検知や管理、ポリシーの策定と対策の実施等を通して、オンライン環境の信頼性と安全性を高めるための取り組みです。 [e003:f16] 一般社団法人トラスト＆セーフティ協会 日本オンライン詐欺対策アライアンス（JASA）設立準備事務局 Email: anti-scam [@] *送信時は [ ] を外してご利用下さい。

evidence.title: 【動画公開】第1四半期の売上高が過去最高を更新。クラウド・AI領域がエンタープライズ事業をけん引 ー ソフトバンク株式会社 2027年3月期 第1四半期 決算説明会
evidence.body: [e001:f01] クラウド・AI領域がエンタープライズ事業をけん引 ー ソフトバンク株式会社 2027年3月期 第1四半期 決算説明会 ソフトバンクのこと 決算説明会 宮川潤一 _MV _RECENT _企業TOP 2026年8月4日、ソフトバンク株式会社は2027年3月期 第1四半期 決算説明会を開催し、代表取締役 社長執行役員 兼 CEOの宮川潤一が、連結業績や各事業の進捗に加え、セブン＆アイ・ホールディングスとの資本業務提携、Neoクラウド事業の米国展開に向けた取り組みなどについて説明しました。 [e001:f02] 第1四半期として過去最高の売上高を達成 各セグメントが通期業績予想に対して順調に進捗 セブン＆アイ・ホールディングスとの資本業務提携で、次世代生活インフラの実現へ Neoクラウド事業の米国展開に向けて「SB Neo, Inc.」を設立 全セグメント増収。 [e001:f03] 第1四半期として過去最高の売上高を達成 2027年3月期 第1四半期の売上高は、前年同期比9％増の1兆8,147億円となり、第1四半期として過去最高を更新しました。 [e001:f04] 営業利益は前年同期比4％増の3,023億円、親会社の所有者に帰属する純利益は同3％増の1,501億円となりました。 [e001:f05] 通期業績予想に対する進捗率は、売上高24％、営業利益27％、純利益27％で、中期経営計画が始まって最初の決算として、いずれも順調に進捗していると説明しました。 [e001:f06] 各セグメントが通期業績予想に対して順調に進捗 エンタープライズ事業は、売上高が前年同期比11％増の2,604億円、営業利益が同28％増と、2桁の増収増益となりました。 [e001:f07] また、クラウド・AI領域の売上高の見通しを開示し、2025年度から2027年度までは、年平均成長率30％の成長継続を見込んでいます。 [e001:f08] コンシューマ事業は、売上高が前年同期比4％増の7,497億円、営業利益は1％減の1,529億円となりました。 [e001:f09] ファイナンス事業は、売上高が前年同期比27％増の1,159億円、営業利益が同76％増の318億円となりました。 [e001:f10] ソフトバンク株式会社、PayPay株式会社および三井住友カード株式会社が、それぞれ1,000億円を出資します。 [e001:f11] Neoクラウド事業の米国展開に向けた協業の一環として、ソフトバンクは第1四半期に、SBエナジーが保有するEnergy Global, LPの優先持分に10億米ドル、約1,600億円を出資しました。 [e001:f12] この影響により、第1四半期のフリー・キャッシュ・フローは1,285億円のマイナスとなりました。 [e001:f13] 2027年3月期 第1四半期は、全セグメントが増収となり、第1四半期として過去最高の売上高を達成しました。 [e001:f14] クラウド・AI領域が成長をけん引したエンタープライズ事業をはじめ、既存事業が順調に進捗する中、国内での大型提携やNeoクラウド事業の米国展開を進めることで、ソフトバンクは「AIとの共存社会を支える社会インフラ企業」への進化を加速します。 [e001:f15] 第1四半期のスマートフォン契約純減に関連し、契約数の減少が一時的なものか、今後の回復見通しや料金競争への対応について質問がありました。 [e001:f16] 質疑応答の詳細をみる 2027年3月期第1四半期 決算説明会 短信、データシートなど決算説明会関連資料 プレゼンテーション資料（PDF形式：4.94MB／50ぺージ） （掲載日：2026年8月3日、最終更新日：2026年8月7日） 文：ソフトバンクニュース編集部。

evidence.title: SoftBank slashed its TSMC stake by more than 70% in Q2, cashing out $270 million as its AI investment focus continues to tilt toward the ecosystem
evidence.body: [e004:f01] SoftBank Group aggressively reduced its U.S.-listed TSMC holdings in the second quarter of 2026, cutting its position by 71.5% and cashing out approximately $270 million, while initiating new positions in Capital One and Life360. [e004:f02] This marks another major adjustment to AI hardware assets following SoftBank's full exit from Nvidia in October 2025, which generated $5.8 billion in proceeds. [e004:f03] SoftBank's AI investment focus is shifting from directly holding leading chip stocks toward broader AI ecosystem segments including OpenAI, robotics, and autonomous driving—reflecting Masayoshi Son's strategic capital reallocation rather than a bearish view on the semiconductor industry.

evidence.title: Acuraの次世代デザインの方向性を示すコンセプトモデル「Acura NEXERA Vision」を世界初公開
evidence.body: [e001:f01] Acura NEXERA Visionは、今年40周年を迎えたAcuraブランドの次世代デザインの方向性を示すコンセプトモデルとして、米国カリフォルニア州のアキュラデザインスタジオで開発されました。 [e001:f02] 同モデルは、ブランドの基本理念であるチャレンジングスピリットに着想を得て、普遍的な美しさに先進性を融合させた次世代Acuraのデザイン言語を提案するコンセプトモデルです。 [e001:f03] ライティングシグネチャー 革新的な「ファントムライティング」を採用し、非点灯時にはボディーラインに溶け込み、点灯時にのみランプが現れることで、シームレスで彫刻的な面構成を実現します。 [e001:f04] また、極薄のヘッドライトおよびテールライトは、Acuraの頭文字である「A」をモチーフにしたライティングシグネチャーとしてブランドアイデンティティーを表現しています。 [e001:f05] このライティングシグネチャーは、ブランド初の２モーターハイブリッドを搭載し、数年以内に発売予定の次期RDXを皮切りに、Acuraの次世代ラインアップに採用していく予定です。 [e001:f06] エクステリアデザイン ワイド＆ローの力強いスタンスに加え、ダッシュ・トゥ・アクスル（フロントタイヤの中心からダッシュボードまでの距離）を長く取ることで、キャビンを後方に配置したパフォーマンスカーならではの伸びやかなプロポーションを実現。 [e001:f07] 特徴的なデュアルヒンジ式バタフライドアが、AcuraのパフォーマンスDNAを大胆に印象づけています。 [e001:f08] インテリアデザイン ドライバーとの一体感と広がり感を高次元で融合したインテリアには、ブラック＆ホワイトを基調とした空間に鮮やかなピンクを配することで印象的なコントラストを創出。 [e001:f09] 再生ポリエステルを使用したAlcantara ®※1 やサーキュラーエコノミーに寄与する本革素材CircuLeather ®※2 、リサイクルアルミニウムなどのサステナブル素材を採用し、環境に配慮した次世代のプレミアム価値を創造しています。 [e001:f10] Alcantara ® はAlcantara S.p.A.の登録商標です CircuLeather ® はミドリオートレザー株式会社の登録商標です Acura NEXERA Visionは、米国カリフォルニア州で開催される、ビンテージカーからレースカーまでさまざまなクルマが集まる祭典、Monterey Car Week（モントレー・カー・ウィーク）のイベント「The Quail（ザ・クエイル）」（現地時間8月14日）および「Pebble Beach Concours d’Elegance（ペブルビーチ・コンクール・デレガンス）」（現地時間8月16日）にて展示されます。 [e001:f11] ホンダ・ディベロップメント・アンド・マニュファクチュアリング・オブ・アメリカ Acura クリエイティブディレクター兼オートデザイン担当副社長 土田 康剛のコメント 「Acuraの40周年を新たな挑戦への節目とし、Acura NEXERA Visionを今後のAcuraのデザイン言語として意味ています。 [e001:f12] この新たなデザインの方向性では、普遍的な美しさと先進技術を融合させることで、Acuraらしい美しさとパフォーマンスを新たな形で表現することを目指しました。 [e001:f13] 今後のAcuraラインアップにおいても、このデザインの方向性を一貫して具現化し、進化させていきます」。

evidence.title: Track preparation problems delay practice at Ontario Honda Dealers Indy in Markham
evidence.body: [e002:f01] First day of Ontario Honda Dealers Indy in Markham cancelled due to incomplete track Skip to main content Toronto Calgary Edmonton Halifax Kitchener Montreal Ottawa Toronto Vancouver Winnipeg About About Us Our Team Where to Find Us Careers & Internships Contact Contact Us Submit a News Tip Speakers Corner Athlete of the Week Advertise With Us Newsletters First day of Ontario Honda Dealers Indy in Markham cancelled due to incomplete track Track preparations remain underway ahead of the 2026 Honda Indy in Markham, Ont., Friday, Aug. [e002:f02] THE CANADIAN PRESS/Sammy Kogan By John Chidley-Hill, The Canadian Press Posted August 14, 2026 1:54 pm. [e002:f03] Last Updated August 14, 2026 7:06 pm. [e002:f04] The first day of practice and qualifying at the only IndyCar event in Canada was cancelled Friday because the track was not completed and officials couldn’t do a final safety check. [e002:f05] “IndyCar is incredibly disappointed that our promoter was not able to complete the track build on time, despite significant support from our team on site,” said IndyCar president J. [e002:f06] “New events can always pose logistical challenges and we join in the frustration of our loyal fans and apologize.” Mark Coburn of Kitchener, Ont., and Scott Stobo of Waterloo, Ont., have been attending the race for 20 years and drove to Markham on Friday morning. [e002:f07] Coburn said it was “good and bad” that the practice and qualifying sessions had been delayed. [e002:f08] “Like good, I can understand that you want a safe track, and safety comes first because it’d be horrible to have an accident and put a bad mark on things,” he said about 30 minutes before the day was officially cancelled. [e002:f09] “There’s been nothing all day today, unfortunately, on the track, which is the attraction and generates interest for fans and new fans, especially in the area.” IndyCar and the City of Markham announced the move from downtown Toronto last September. [e002:f10] “I was hoping they’d go to Canadian Tire Motorsport Park (in Clarington, Ont.) or something.” The Ontario government announced on July 27 that it had invested $1.5 million into the event. [e002:f11] Four days later the federal government announced it had put in $3.5 million. [e002:f12] There were thousands of fans around the Markham track with the temperature reaching 26 C or 31 C with humidity. [e002:f13] Saturday will be a significantly longer day at the track, with IndyCar holding both of its practice sessions and its qualifying round in the day. evidence.title: A Billion-Dollar Reset: Honda Terminated 3 Near-Launch EVs, And Suffered Its First Net Loss Since 1957
evidence.body: [e003:f01] Sign in to your CarBuzz account Not unlike a handful of other brands wary about electrification, Honda took a while to come around to developing its own EV. [e003:f02] Its stint with General Motors to develop and produce the Prologue and Acura ZDX on GM’s Ultium EV platform ended in July 2026, with the project officially dissolved by the end of the year. [e003:f03] The original succession plan for models to follow the Prologue was the Honda 0 SUV and 0 Saloon , and the Acura RSX – all three of which were to be built at Honda’s EV Hub at its Marysville, Ohio, plant. [e003:f04] The company has decided this was no longer a viable plan and canceled the upcoming projects in favor of nailing down new tech. [e003:f05] The situation also didn’t help the firm when it took a multi-billion-dollar loss to pause its plans. [e003:f06] Honda had three new EVs in the pipeline ready to rock at the company’s shiny EV plant, but as of March 2026, that’s no longer the plan. [e003:f07] Honda 0 Saloon Prototype at CES 2025 Honda Honda 0 SUV Prototype at CES 2025 Honda Acura RSX Prototype Jared Rosenholtz/CarBuzz/Valnet Honda is stepping back from its planned EV endeavors to focus all efforts on perfecting solid-state battery chemistry. [e003:f08] To recoup the investment in its new plant, the EV Hub was retrofitted, and teams pivoted to working on new battery technology. [e003:f09] The total cost of this decision comes to $15.7 billion, something Honda isn’t proud of in the slightest, despite this being the company’s first net loss since its 1957 debut on the Tokyo Stock Exchange. [e003:f10] Recently, Honda announced it was now working with QuantumScape, a battery technology company based in San Jose, California, to develop solid-state lithium-metal batteries for its EVs. [e003:f11] Two years ago, it was ready to start development and testing of new EVs made in-house, but that’s since been canned thanks to a multitude of reasons. [e003:f12] In June, Honda announced it would begin working with another company to develop solid-state batteries, a type of battery that will advance EVs in areas such as charging times and efficiency. [e003:f13] On top of shifting who's responsible for helping Honda gain a leg up in battery development, the company announced it was canceling plans to build an EV plant in Canada after backing away from its electric powertrain development. [e003:f14] Honda 0 Saloon Prototype at CES 2025 Honda Honda recently announced a third-generation Ridgeline set for 2029 , and while there’s been no word on powertrains, it’s going out of production at the end of this year because of its aging 3.5-liter V6. [e003:f15] Honda was not the only brand to reconsider its EV plans, but it was the only one actively investing capital to ramp up EV production. [e003:f16] The technology it dumped money into developing with other companies was already outdated and wouldn’t support the production of current models, pushing its return on investment further down the road.

evidence.title: Honda Racing Corporation Launches Heritage Racing Programme
evidence.body: [e004:f01] The new HRC Heritage Racing Programme offers sales, restoration, service and trackside support of Honda and Acura vintage racing cars that have won some of the biggest races around the world – including the legendary endurance races at Le Mans, Sebring, and Daytona. [e004:f02] “Classic race cars never die, their myth and aura just grow, and the HRC Heritage Racing Programme is all about keeping our incredible Honda and Acura race cars doing what they were born to do ― race,” said David Salters, the President of HRC US. [e004:f03] “As the builder of these race-winning machines, and custodian of the original IP and knowledge, HRC is uniquely equipped to restore them to their original form, ensuring they can return to historic racing competition authentically and ready to be enjoyed by our customers and fans.” And the first car up for sale through this new programme is the #26 Andretti Green Racing Acura ARX-01a, which took the LMP2 class victory in the 2007 Twelve Hours of Sebring – driven by Dario Franchitti, Bryan Herta, and Tony Kanaan. [e004:f04] It will headline HRC’s display at The Quail, A Motorsports Gathering on Friday, 14 August. [e004:f05] Adorned in its XM Satellite Radio livery (forerunner to today’s SiriusXM), the Acura ARX-01a was Acura’s first purpose-built endurance racing prototype for North American competition, with both the car and engine designed and developed by HRC in the United States. [e004:f06] “The 2007 XM Acura ARX-01a made you feel like a hero, it made you feel like the best driver in the world, you just pushed harder and harder and it just kept coming back for more,” said Franchitti. [e004:f07] “It’s just a pleasure to drive, the 2007 XM Acura ARX-01a is a special car for anyone who was lucky enough to get to drive it, and you can’t say that for a lot of cars.” Vehicle restoration through the HRC Heritage Racing Programme is carried out in meticulous detail, starting through each vehicle’s original homologation documents, along with notes and photographs from the original HRC engineers who were involved in each project. [e004:f08] Each car is torn down and reassembled with new and reconditioned parts – with some updated materials in the interest of safety. [e004:f09] “HRC restores these historic Honda and Acura race cars to a level enabling them to be driven and feel as original as possible, while still making some updates ― especially with regards to electronics,” said John Whiteman, HRC US Commercial Manager. [e004:f10] “Our approach maintains the authenticity of design and driving experience of these iconic race cars and adds modifications for safety performance and to ensure they are user-friendly for their new owners.” More than 20 iconic Honda and Acura racing vehicles will be featured at Monterey Car Week from 12–16 August, including Motorlux, The Quail, the Rolex Monterey Motorsports Reunion, and the Pebble Beach Concours d’Elegance. [e004:f11] These include endurance racing vehicles that have been restored by HRC, leading to the successful launch of the Heritage Racing Programme. [e004:f12] The 2010 Strakka Racing Acura ARX-01c that won LMP2 at the 2010 24 Hours of Le Mans will race at the Rolex Monterey Motorsports Reunion on Saturday, when Nick Yelloly, current star of the Acura Meyer Shank Racing GTP programme, drives the car in the Scott Pruett Legends event before the car is exhibited at Pebble Beach. [e004:f13] Also on display is the Acura NSX GT3, chassis number 5, wearing the striking “Lady Liberty” livery as it did when MSR drivers Andy Lally and Katherine Legge took GTD class honors in the 2017 Six Hours of the Glen. [e004:f14] HRC has also restored four Acura ARX-05 DPi prototypes which currently race in the Historic SportsCar Racing (HSR) Series, including a 2019 Acura Team Penske ARX-05 that will be exhibited – along with a 2001 Reynard 01i/Honda Champ Car, driven by the legendary Gil de Ferran to the 2001 CART Championship, and now owned by McLaren CEO Zak Brown. [e004:f15] While currently focused on the restoration of historic endurance racers, HRC US plans to expand the new Heritage Racing Programme to include more historic Honda-powered IndyCar machines in the near future. [e004:f16] Other historic sports cars that will be at Monterey Car Week include Comptech Racing’s Spice/Acura GTP Lights prototype that won its class at Daytona and Sebring, Team Kunimitsu’s 1996 Honda NSX GT2 from the 24 Hours of Le Mans, and the Raybrig Team Kunimitsu Honda NSX-GT which won the 2018 and 2020 SUPER GT GT500 championships.

evidence.title: Honda Launches Heritage Racing Program, and You Can Drive ‘Em!
evidence.body: [e005:f01] Indy cars, F1, LeMans, all kinds of two-and four-wheeled Hondas and Acuras. [e005:f02] Well, now you can, given enough money. [e005:f03] Honda just announced its new HRC Heritage Racing Program that includes the sale, restoration, and trackside support of historic Honda and Acura race machines that have won races and championships around the world, including at Le Mans, Sebring, Daytona, and Laguna ’re not all going on sale at once. [e005:f04] The first car available for purchase and restoration is the Sebring-winning V8-powered #26 XM Satellite Radio AGR Acura ARX-01a, Honda announced at Monterey, where the car will be shown at the HRC display at the Quail on Friday.“The Andretti Green Racing ‘XM’ car was the first purpose-built Acura endurance racer and the first car and engine designed and developed by HRC in the US,” Honda said. [e005:f05] “Winner of the LMP2 class at the 2007 Sebring 12 Hours, its debut race, it was driven to victory by Dario Franchitti, Bryan Herta, and Tony Kanaan.””Classic race cars never die, their myth and aura just grow, and the HRC Heritage Racing Program is all about keeping our incredible Honda and Acura race cars doing what they were born to do—race,” said David Salters, president of HRC US. [e005:f06] “As the builder of these race-winning machines, and custodian of the original IP and knowledge, HRC is uniquely equipped to restore them to their original form, ensuring they can return to historic racing competition authentically and ready to be enjoyed by our customers and fans.”“The 2007 XM Acura ARX-01a made you feel like a hero, it made you feel like the best driver in the world, you just pushed harder and harder, and it just kept coming back for more,” said Dario Franchitti, who drove the 2007 XM Acura ARX-01a to multiple victories. [e005:f07] “It’s just a pleasure to drive, the 2007 XM Acura ARX-01a is a special car for anyone who was lucky enough to get to drive it, and you can’t say that for a lot of cars.”The HRC Heritage Racing Program delivers restorations of unmatched authenticity, meticulously performed utilizing the race machine’s original homologation documents, plus notes and photographs from the original HRC engineers involved in each project. [e005:f08] The work is supported by extensive HRC archives of technical data ensuring each car and engine is restored race car is completely torn down and reassembled with new and reconditioned parts and, in the interest of safety, some updated materials. [e005:f09] Electronics are modernized and the engines are rebuilt at HRC US headquarters in Santa Clarita, California. [e005:f10] Finally, post-restoration, each race machine is thoroughly track tested, and HRC engineers are available for track support and to assist the new owner in competition.“HRC restores these historic Honda and Acura race cars to a level enabling them to be driven and feel as original as possible, while still making some updates—especially with regards to electronics,” said HRC US Commercial Manager John Whiteman. [e005:f11] “Our approach maintains the authenticity of design and driving experience of these iconic race cars and adds modifications for safety performance and to ensure they are user-friendly for their new owners.”HRC has already restored four Acura ARX-05 DPi endurance racers that competed in IMSA’s Historic SportsCar Racing Series, including a 2019 Acura Team Penske car that will be displayed at Laguna Seca this weekend. [e005:f12] It also completed the refurbishment of the 2001 Reynard 01i raced by the late Gil de Ferran for Team Penske in the 2001 CART championship—offering a period correct Honda engine, supporting the engine fire up, and inspecting key electronic components for the car’s current owner, Zak Brown, CEO of McLaren Racing, long-time friend of de Ferran. [e005:f13] Brown will turn laps at Weathertech Raceway Laguna Seca as part of the Rolex Monterey Motorsports Reunion this prices were mentioned for the purchase or restoration of any of these models. [e005:f14] Don’t ask, just send a blank check.

evidence.title: ホンダ、2027年3月期 第1四半期決算を発表 電動化戦略見直しもHEV好調で営業利益増
アステモ、新社長にホンダ四輪本部長の井上勝史氏 竹内弘平社長は退任 ホンダ四輪事業の立て直しを全面支援
evidence.body: [e001:f01] 6月25日の定時株主総会と7月1日の臨時取締役会を経て正式決定する。 [e001:f02] 井上氏はホンダの欧州や中国の責任者などを経て、電動事業開発部門のトップ、昨年4月には四輪事業本部長に就いたが、6月にホンダの取締役退任が決まっていた。 [e001:f03] ホンダは日立が保有するアステモの株式21％分を取得し、出資比率を61％に引き上げて子会社化する予定でいる。 [e001:f04] 電気自動車（EV）戦略の失敗で業績が悪化している同社は、ソフトウエア・デファインド・ビークル（SDV）やハイブリッド車（HV）に重点を置く方針に軌道修正した。 [e001:f05] アステモはSDVや電動車向けを含むパワートレイン技術に強い。 [e001:f06] ホンダはアステモの先進技術や開発力を高く評価しており、連携を強化する。 [e001:f07] 今回、ホンダの四輪事業部門で実務経験の長い井上氏にトップ交代することで、ホンダの四輪事業の立て直しについて、系列サプライヤーとして全面的に支える体制を整える。 [e001:f08] 竹内社長もホンダ出身で、2023年7月にアステモの社長に就いた。 [e001:f09] ホンダでは財務・管理部門が長く、アステモでは前任社長時代の品質問題を踏まえた対応や財務体質の改善、株式公開に向けた準備などを担ってきた。 [e001:f10] 井上勝史氏（いのうえ・かつし）1986年3月、横浜国立大学経営学部卒、同年4月ホンダ入社。 [e001:f11] 2015年ホンダカーズインディア社長、16年ホンダ執行役員、欧州地域本部長、20年常務執行役員兼中国本部長兼本田技研工業（中国）投資総経理兼本田技研科技（中国）総経理、23年執行役専務兼電動事業開発本部長、25年取締役執行役専務兼四輪事業本部長兼リスクマネジメントオフィサー、25年6月同取締役執行役専務、26年4月同取締役。
